intro.h2: New-looking tubs and tile without ripping anything out
paragraphs: B&J Refinishing handles tub refinishing in Woodway, TX and across the Central Texas area. Instead of tearing out a stained tub, a dated tile surround or a tired countertop, Frank resurfaces it in place. A tub can look brand new in just hours, and tile jobs are usually done within two days.

Customers notice the difference right away. One reviewer's rusted, peeling tub came out like new in about two hours, and he wrote that Frank "did magic." Tile surrounds, fiberglass units, countertops and vanities can be refinished the same way, in many colors, and B&J advertises a 5 year warranty on most work.

services.h2: Tub refinishing in Woodway, TX, plus tile and counters

items.name: Bathtub refinishing
items.blurb: Rusted, chipped, stained or peeling tubs get a fresh, glossy finish without demo, from builder-grade tubs to older originals. Tub refinishing is the job Google reviewers mention most, and one says his old tub came out like new in about two hours.

image.alt: Refinished white bathtub below a white subway tile wall

items.name: Tile refinishing
items.blurb: Outdated tile surrounds, tub decks and shower floors can be refinished in a new color instead of torn out. B&J says tile refinishing can save you a lot on a project, with no demo or ripping out, and most jobs done within two days or less.

image.alt: Before and after of a stand-up shower: stripped walls on the left, refinished smooth white walls and floor on the right

items.name: Fiberglass tub and shower units
items.blurb: Dull or yellowed fiberglass tub and shower units are resurfaced to look brand new in just hours. The finish covers walls, soap shelves and the tub itself, so the whole unit matches again without replacing it.

image.alt: Fiberglass tub and shower unit resurfaced in bright white with molded shelves

items.name: Countertops and vanities
items.blurb: Kitchen countertops and bathroom vanities can be refinished too. One couple who moved to Texas from Colorado had B&J do their kitchen, tub, tile surround and vanities in one go. Surfaces are masked off carefully before coating.

image.alt: Bathroom vanity countertop masked with paper during resurfacing, coated in a light stone finish

items.name: Clawfoot tubs and repairs
items.blurb: Antique and clawfoot tubs can be refinished too. B&J also handles repairs: the logo lists them alongside tubs, tiles and countertops, and customers say Frank comes back when a surface he refinished needs attention, even years later.

image.alt: Clawfoot tub with a refinished white interior and black exterior

why_choose_us.h2: Why Central Texas homeowners call Frank

items.title: Done in hours, not weeks
items.text: Tubs can look brand new in just hours and tile jobs are usually finished within two days or less, so your bathroom is not out of action for weeks.

items.title: 5 year warranty on most work
items.text: B&J Refinishing advertises a 5 year warranty on most work. Ask which parts of your job it covers when you get your quote, and keep the paperwork.

items.title: On time and fairly priced
items.text: Gary A. says Frank showed up on time to give an estimate, came back as promised and charged an extremely reasonable price. Promptness is another review topic.

items.title: He comes back
items.text: JJ S. had a 1952 tub refinished in 2017. Eight years later Frank did a minor repair and even returned to remove the tape. Customers call him a good guy.

about.text: B&J Refinishing is a resurfacing company based in Woodway, serving the Central Texas area. Frank is the technician customers meet, and reviewers describe him as professional, knowledgeable and a stand-up guy who knows his craft. The business refinishes tubs, tile, fiberglass units, countertops and vanities, and has been sharing its work on Facebook since at least 2016. One of its posts says it plainly: don't replace it, refinish it. With many colors to choose from, an old bathroom can get a new look without demolition.

image.alt: Tub masked with brown paper during a B&J Refinishing job, freshly coated in white

steps.title: Free quote
steps.text: Call (254) 523-5754 for a free quote. Frank can come out to look at the tub, tile or countertop and give you an estimate.

steps.title: Pick a color
steps.text: Choose from the many colors B&J offers, or keep your tub, tile or counter a classic white.

steps.title: Prep and mask
steps.text: The area around the tub or counter is masked off with paper and tape so only the surface being refinished gets coated.

steps.title: Refinish
steps.text: The surface is resurfaced in place. Tubs often take just hours and most tile jobs are done within two days.

steps.title: Cure and enjoy
steps.text: Once the finish has cured, the tape comes off and your tub, tile or counter is ready to use.

items.text:
Frank is a stand up guy. Professional, knowledgeable and prompt. Showed up to give us an estimate on time. The price was extremely reasonable. We set up an appointment and he was here as promised, finished the job in about 2 hours. And Wow!

In November 2017 Frank refinished my old 1952 yo tub.  He did a beautiful job.  Now 8 years later the tub needed a minor repair. service_area.h2: Serving Woodway and the Central Texas area
service_area.text: B&J Refinishing's Facebook page lists Woodway, Texas, and the company describes itself as a resurfacing business in the Central Texas area. The work is done at your home, since tubs, tile and counters are refinished in place rather than hauled away. If you are not sure whether your town is covered, call (254) 523-5754 during business hours, Monday to Friday, and ask for a free quote.

items.a: B&J says it can have a tub looking brand new in just hours, and that tile jobs are usually completed within two days or less. One reviewer says Frank finished his tub in about two hours. Ask when you book how long to wait before using it.

Yes. B&J Refinishing advertises a 5 year warranty on most work. Because it applies to most jobs rather than every one, ask Frank which parts of your project are covered and what care the finish needs when he gives you the quote.

Yes. Facebook posts from B&J Refinishing invite people to get a free quote by calling (254) 523-5754. A reviewer says Frank showed up on time to give the estimate, and the price was extremely reasonable. He then set an appointment and was there as promised.

Bathtubs, including older tubs like a 1952 original and clawfoot tubs, tile surrounds and floors, fiberglass tub and shower units, countertops and vanities. The logo sums it up: tubs, tiles, repairs and countertops. There are many colors to choose from, or you can stay with classic white.

items.q: Where do you work and when?
items.a: B&J Refinishing works in the Central Texas area, and its Facebook page is listed in Woodway. Google lists hours Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, closed on weekends. Call (254) 523-5754 or email b.j_refinishing@yahoo.com to ask whether your town is covered.
